verdicts.reason: A breaks the design: the can is pulled away from its circle, so the headline and body copy sit on top of the circle. The 'Find It Near You' CTA has shrunk to an illegible pill floating in the middle, the badges are scattered to the top and bottom, and GLACIER now sits below the headline. B keeps the original two-column layout with the can centred in its circle and a clear brand, headline, copy, badges, CTA order; its only flaw is slightly heavy empty space at the bottom.

A keeps the original structure intact with clean alignment and hierarchy, and only needs minor polish to the vertical spacing. B shrinks the product can to a tiny icon and leaves the circle empty under the headline. Its CTA and 'Summer Only' badge are too small to read, the 'Back by Demand' badge is cut off from its group, and GLACIER sits below the headline. The brand imagery is effectively gone.
